model.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (Google)
model.selection_reason: Confirmed live generation works. Gemini 3.8 returned HTTP 503 high demand and 2.5 Flash returned HTTP 404, so select 3.5 Flash-Lite explicitly with minimal thinking; no silent fallback.

budget.notes: Planning conversion, not live FX. No caching, batch discounts, or temporary promotional prices. Token-only budget; excludes taxes and infrastructure. Reasoning tokens can increase output costs.

settings.selection_basis: User requested existing Gemini and Groq keys only. Verified IDs with both authenticated model-list endpoints on 2026-10-15. Four varied candidates for the same six-question pilot; this is not the original all-provider leaderboard top four.
